title: Chips, tool card titles and buttons can't be highlighted or copied

steps.headline: Select all now highlights only the conversation's words. Chips, buttons, tool card titles and the message box stay plain.
steps.changed: Quick chips, status bar chips, tool card titles, buttons and the empty message box's placeholder can no longer be highlighted, by select all or by dragging across them.
steps.measured: Select all on this screen picks up 2,925 characters, down from 4,204
steps.notice: Copying a stretch of conversation pastes just the messages, without chip labels, button names or tool card titles mixed in.
steps.risk: Button text you did want to copy can't be copied now. Clickable file names inside messages are the exception and stay copyable.

steps.path: Right-click a tool card title, or right-click a message and choose Copy
steps.headline: Right-clicking a tool card title shows no menu, and copying a whole message leaves tool card titles out.
steps.changed: The right-click menu treats titles and buttons like the rest of the unselectable parts. Copy and Ask about this on a message use only the message's own words.
steps.notice: Right-clicking "Ran a command" does nothing. A copied message no longer pastes lines like "Ran a command".
steps.risk: Ask about this is gone from tool card titles. It still works on messages, code and files.

steps.path: A window with no conversation open, press Ctrl+A
steps.headline: On the No Active Session screen, select all highlights nothing.
steps.changed: The screen title and the New Session and Resume Session buttons can no longer be highlighted.
steps.measured: Select all picks up 9 characters, down from 440
steps.notice: Nothing on this screen lights up when you press Ctrl+A or drag across it.

steps.path: A brand-new chat, press Ctrl+A while it starts up
steps.headline: A new chat's "Initializing session…" line, chips, message box and status bar stay plain on select all.
steps.changed: The start-up line and the "Start a conversation with your assistant" line that follows it can no longer be highlighted, alongside the chips and message box.
steps.measured: Select all on a new chat picks up 1,957 characters, down from 2,775
steps.notice: Pressing Ctrl+A in a fresh window lights up nothing. The "Start a conversation" line isn't pictured: the test app's pretend chat never finishes starting.
